description: This file defines a class 'FinancialValidations' which contains static methods to validate various financial calculation inputs such as dates, rates, frequencies, prices, and yields. It ensures data correctness for financial functions within PHPSpreadsheet's calculation engine.

classes.name: FinancialValidations
classes.description: Provides static methods for validating various financial calculation inputs such as dates, rates, frequencies, etc., ensuring they are in the correct format and within valid ranges.

methods.name: validateDate
methods.description: Validates and converts a date input to a float date value.

methods.name: validateSettlementDate
methods.description: Validates and converts a settlement date input.

methods.name: validateMaturityDate
methods.description: Validates and converts a maturity date input.

methods.name: validateFloat
methods.description: Validates that a value is numeric and converts it to float.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Validates that a value is numeric and converts it to integer.

methods.name: validateRate
methods.description: Validates that a rate is non-negative float.

methods.name: validateFrequency
methods.description: Validates that the frequency value matches predefined constants (annual, semi-annual, quarterly).

methods.name: validateBasis
methods.description: Validates that the basis value is numeric and within 0-4 range.

methods.name: validatePrice
methods.description: Validates that a price is non-negative float.

methods.name: validateParValue
methods.description: Validates that a par value is non-negative float.

methods.name: validateYield
methods.description: Validates that a yield is non-negative float.

methods.name: validateDiscount
methods.description: Validates that a discount is positive float.
